questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

She will be / write her / examination by this / time tomorrow.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'write her'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'writing her'** should be used instead of **'write her'.**
 
• The **future continuous tense**, sometimes also referred to as the **future progressive tense**, is a verb tense that indicates that something will occur in the **future and continue for an expected length of time.**
 
• It is formed using the construction **will + be + the present participle (the root verb + -ing)**.
 
 
• *Example: Michael **will be running **a marathon this Saturday.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.****
 

Correct Sentence:__** *She will be **writing her **examination by this time tomorrow.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

In the theatre, the audience threw flowers on the screen.

options.text: In the theatre, flowers were thrown by the audience.
In the theatre, flowers had been thrown by the audience.
In the theatre, flowers was thrown by the audience.
In the theatre, flowers are thrown by the audience.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'In the theatre, the audience threw flowers on the screen.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'the audience'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Flowers. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'threw' will be changed into 'were thrown'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *In the theatre, flowers were thrown by the audience.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The Taj Mahal's history is also one of the world's greatest love stories known to everyone.

B. She was the neice of Meherunissa who was married to Prince Salim (later the Empress Nur Jahan.)

C. It all started in 1607, when Mughal Prince Khurram, first laid eyes on the lovely Arjumand Banu Begum.

D. Khurram, the son of Emperor Jahangir, Voiced his wish to marry Arjumand, and their marriage was celebrated with great pomp.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**ACBD**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para-jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it begins with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence A **will be the first sentence because it is an introductory statement that tells us about the love story of the Taj Mahal.
 
• **Sentence C **will be used after it because it tells us how Prince Khurram fell in love with Arjumand Banu Begum in 1607.
 
• Banu Begum was the niece of Meherunissa (Nur Jahan). Meherunissa was the wife of Jahangir. Hence, **Sentence B **will be used next.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence D** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence: 
 
 
• **A**: The Taj Mahal's history is also one of the world's greatest love stories known to everyone.
 
• **C**: It all started in 1607, when Mughal Prince Khurram, first laid eyes on the lovely Arjumand Banu Begum.
 
• **B**: She was the neice of Meherunissa who was married to Prince Salim (later the Empress Nur Jahan.)
 
• **D**: Khurram, the son of Emperor Jahangir, Voiced his wish to marry Arjumand, and their marriage was celebrated with great pomp.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *The Taj Mahal's history is also one of the world's greatest love stories known to everyone. It all started in 1607, when Mughal Prince Khurram, first laid eyes on the lovely Arjumand Banu Begum. She was the neice of Meherunissa who was married to Prince Salim (later the Empress Nur Jahan.) Khurram, the son of Emperor Jahangir, Voiced his wish to marry Arjumand, and their marriage was celebrated with great pomp.*
